title: Seven-FE-model range of L4-L5 IDP under follower compression (Dreischarf 2014)

quantity.name: IDP (FE model predictions)
quantity.definition: L4-L5 nucleus pressure predicted by 7 models under follower compression; min-max across models. NOT experimental data.

source.authors: Dreischarf M, Zander T, Shirazi-Adl A, Puttlitz CM, Adam CJ, Chen CS, Goel VK, Kiapour A, Kim YH, Labus KM, Little JP, Park WM, Wang YH, Wilke HJ, Rohlmann A, Schmidt H
source.n: 7 FE models (one of 8 did not run compression)

protocol.summary: Follower compression up to 1000 N, no moment; L5 fixed.
how_to_simulate: Apply follower load 0-1000 N along the lumbar curve
Read L4-L5 nucleus pressure at 300 and 1000 N
protocol.notes: Model 5 (highest) has 0.13 MPa offset at 0 N; Model 6 (lowest) predicts IDP well below in vitro. Text: 6 of 7 models within in vitro range at 1000 N. Median across models not resolvable (overlapping lines). Figures in the QUT eprints author version are low-resolution embedded bitmaps (~550x420 px for a 4-panel figure); digitised by pixel analysis of the extracted image against gridlines.

extraction.check_notes: Lines sampled at columns for 281-320 N and 978-988 N: magenta (Model 5) 0.47-0.51 / 1.24-1.26 (extrapolated 1.27 at 1000 N); red (Model 6) 0.08-0.09 / 0.275-0.28.

pass_rule.rule: PASS = inside in vitro range AND inside model range; MARGINAL = one
